dict.string: VoiceOver Audio Split asks VoiceOver to announce changes in your VoiceOver voice, and, if you set presets for websites, asks Safari or Chrome which website is open.

VoiceOver Audio Split uses the microphone for the microphone check, which listens for a few seconds to tell you whether you sound clear, and, if you turn them on, to hear voice commands such as “Audio Split, quiet everything” or “Launch VoiceOver training”. Nothing is recorded or saved.

VoiceOver Audio Split recognizes voice commands, such as “Audio Split, quiet everything” or “Launch VoiceOver training”, on your Mac, only if you turn them on in Settings. What you say is never recorded or saved. Only if you ask it to find a control is that request sent to Anthropic, through Do It for Me.

VoiceOver Audio Split uses the camera to read text, labels and codes you hold up, identify colors and light, and check your framing before a video call. Pictures are analyzed on this Mac and never saved; only the money identifier sends a picture, and only when you ask.
VoiceOver Audio Split moves VoiceOver speech to one ear and all other sounds to the other ear. Nothing is recorded or saved.
